about: The source model of a Neuroglancer precomputed volume (spec/zarrify/precomputed.md §11 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/precomputed.md#11-neuroglancer-precomputed-profile>): the elements a parser emits in a store IR (conventions §8.9 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/conventions.md#89-stores>), the tables of data types and encodings, and the roles of the info document and of each of its scales. The parser checks this schema as it reads the document. The role `info` rejects the input. The role `scale`, and the rule of the sharding object after it, only keep that scale from the layout: its message is the reason recorded.

data_types.about: data_type: the bytes per element; the Zarr data_type is the same name

elements.about: The store IR of a precomputed volume: the listing (directories and objects, conventions §8.9 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/conventions.md#89-stores>), and the one document the profile reads, held whole. `<m>` is a member name, named by the rule of spec/zarrify/nd2.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/nd2.md#53-elements> with `gaps` and `json` the fixed names.

info.about: the info document, held: its bytes are in ir/held

children.<m>: ascii[n]: the bytes of the value of the top-level member <m>, as written (JSON text); a member given twice is two values, the later one named <m>~ with index 1, and so on
children.gaps/<o>: the rest: braces, names, colons, commas and whitespace (the whole document when it has no member)
children.json: ascii[s]: in place of the members and gaps, the whole document, when it has more than 4096 top-level members (json.rs MAX_MEMBERS, shared by the store formats)

<k>.about: every other object (chunks, shards, provenance, meshes, skeletons and the objects of a scale that is not presented): referenced, one leaf, or empty

candidate.about: the info document, before it is read

constraints.message: {key}: JSON document of {size} bytes exceeds 16777216
{key}: invalid JSON: the document is empty

info.about: the info document (spec/zarrify/precomputed.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/precomputed.md#2-the-info-document>), read by spec/zarrify.md §1.6 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify.md#16-json-documents>

constraints.message: info is not a JSON object
info: @type {type_} is not a volume
info: data_type {data_type} is not supported
info: num_channels {num_channels} is not 1 to 65535 channels
info: type {kind_} is not a string
info: scales is not a nonempty array

scale.about: a scale of the info document (spec/zarrify/precomputed.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/precomputed.md#3-scales>). A failed constraint keeps the scale from the layout, its message the reason recorded

constraints.message: the scale is not an object
its key is not a string
its size is not 3 positive integers
its resolution is not 3 positive numbers
its chunk_sizes is not a nonempty array
its first chunk size is not 3 integers from 1 to 4294967295
its voxel_offset is not 3 integers
its encoding is not a string
its encoding {encoding} has no decoder
jpeg holds uint8 in 1 or 3 channels, not {data_type} in {num_channels}
png holds uint8 or uint16 in at most 4 channels, not {data_type} in {num_channels}
compressed_segmentation holds uint32 or uint64, not {data_type}
its compressed_segmentation_block_size is not 3 positive integers
compresso holds uint8 to uint64 in 1 channel, not {data_type} in {num_channels}
crackle holds uint8 to uint64 in 1 channel, not {data_type} in {num_channels}
jxl holds uint8 in 1 channel, not {data_type} in {num_channels}
fpzip holds float32 or float64, not {data_type}
kempressed holds float32 or float64, not {data_type}
zfpc holds int32, int64, float32 or float64, not {data_type}

sharding.about: a scale's sharding object (spec/zarrify/precomputed.md §4 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/precomputed.md#4-shards>). A failed constraint keeps the scale from the layout, its message the reason recorded

constraints.message: its sharding is not an object
its sharding @type {type_} is not neuroglancer_uint64_sharded_v1
its preshift_bits is not an integer from 0 to 64
its minishard_bits is not an integer from 0 to 32
its shard_bits is not an integer from 0 to 64
its preshift_bits, minishard_bits and shard_bits are more than 64 bits
its minishard_index_encoding {minishard_index_encoding} is not raw or gzip
its data_encoding {data_encoding} is not raw or gzip
a sharded scale has more than one chunk size
its hash {hash} scatters chunks across shards, so no shard is a box of chunks
